Signing key_version is deliberately the string 1 to match the existing signer wire; evidence wrap uses numeric 1. Verify ACL parameter type behavior against the deployed OpenBao version before issuance.

Reuse recorded provider identities and public key observations; only recheck targeted pins, state and expiry when applying. Do not repeat broad discovery.
